task.text: "My team and I have been researching Elder Dragons for weeks now. But one Elder Dragon has been recently sighted - one that we've got no research on. This new species of Elder Dragon seems to be a variant of another Elder Dragon we've been researching - the Elder Dragon 'Malzeno'. The new variant we've been researching seems to be the original form of Malzeno before it developed symbiosis with the winged parasites called 'Qurio'. I've dubbed this recently-discovered Elder Dragon variant as 'Primordial Malzeno'." - Irene, monster researcher
